recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; the current specification satisfies the issue and no redundant prose or source correction is needed.
issue_request: FHIR-22146 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to add HealthcareService to the MedicationRequest.performer choice because the element already allowed CareTeam and Organization.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to merge commit d338b629407370eccfc6dcaf5bb04304123a677a. Inspecting that merge shows the old medicationrequest-spreadsheet.xml performer reference list was updated to include HealthcareService; commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 later carried that target profile into structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. The related later issue FHIR-35895 changed MedicationRequest.performer cardinality to 0..* while retaining HealthcareService in the target profile list.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml already lists http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/HealthcareService as a MedicationRequest.performer targetProfile.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Pharmacy issue changed cardinality for the same MedicationRequest.performer element while preserving the HealthcareService target profile.
